img_784.description: Very noisy image. Centre shows a four-legged animal in profile facing left, with a head bearing curled horns, slender legs and a body darker at the front; a painted-over dark patch sits just left of the head. Faint small figures/objects around the edges (a star-like shape lower right, curled shapes lower centre).
img_784.central_figure: a four-legged horned animal, like a ram or goat
img_784.sign_reason: curled horns on a four-legged animal suggest a ram; no fish tail visible so Capricorn less likely, but goat cannot be excluded

img_260.description: Heavy noise. A dark low, elongated body lying horizontally in the centre, with a long tail or neck curving up and over on the right side; faint script-like marks scattered around.
img_260.central_figure: a low dark animal lying down with a curved upturned tail
img_260.sign_reason: silhouette could be a lion with raised tail or another beast; no clear diagnostic features

img_925.description: Extremely noisy. Faint outlines in the centre of two elongated horizontal shapes, one above the other, within a curved outline; edges show faint ring structures.
img_925.central_figure: possibly two fish-like shapes one above the other
img_925.sign_reason: two horizontal elongated forms resemble a pair of fish, but outlines are barely visible

img_631.description: Image cut into shuffled tiles plus noise. Fragments show box- or tub-like dark rectangles, a few small figure-like strokes and a branching shape; no coherent central picture survives.
img_631.central_figure: not recoverable; scattered fragments including tub-like rectangles
img_631.sign_reason: tiles are shuffled so the central figure cannot be reconstructed

img_844.description: Almost pure noise; only very faint lines and a small dark blob at right (probably a painted patch). No figure discernible.

img_545.description: Noisy. Centre has a dark triangular mass, like a cloaked or robed figure, with thin lines extending to the lower left and some small marks below.
img_545.central_figure: possibly a standing robed figure holding a long object (bow/crossbow?)
img_545.sign_reason: shape could be a figure with a bow (Sagittarius) but too indistinct to commit

img_801.description: Noisy. Two standing figures in the centre: a faint one on the left with an arc over the head, and a clearer upright robed figure on the right with long draped lines down to the feet.
img_801.central_figure: two standing human figures side by side
img_801.sign_reason: a pair of standing human figures suggests the twins; could also be a single figure (Virgo) if the left shape is not a person

img_782.description: Noisy. A curved thick arc at top centre, a rounded outline below, and some radiating strokes on the right; looks like part of a creature or object but indistinct.
img_782.central_figure: an indistinct curved shape, possibly an animal body or vessel

img_694.description: Noisy. Centre shows a small dark horizontal creature with several short projections (legs/claws) and two upward strokes above it, like antennae or raised claws.
img_694.central_figure: a small low many-legged creature, perhaps a scorpion or crab
img_694.sign_reason: elongated low body with legs and raised claw-like strokes; could equally be Cancer

img_593.description: Noisy. Writing-like strokes at the top centre and a few dark smudges at left; no clear central figure.

img_361.description: Noisy. Faint horizontal bar across the upper centre with a short vertical element in the middle, and two rounded shapes hanging lower left and lower right.
img_361.central_figure: possibly a balance/scales with two pans
img_361.sign_reason: horizontal beam with central post and two pan-like circles below suggests scales

img_740.description: Noisy but clearer. A dark four-legged animal standing in profile facing left, head raised with pointed ears or small horns, standing over a rectangular box-like base; a painted dark circle at far left edge.
img_740.central_figure: a four-legged animal (bull or similar beast) standing on/over a box-like base
img_740.sign_reason: stocky four-legged animal with small horns/ears; could be a bull, but goat or lion not excluded

recognise_source: yes, probably: the style (zodiac-type central figures, small figures and script-like text around a circle) looks like the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), though the degraded images make this uncertain
